observations.additional_issues: Baseline A and revised A/B ask for more explicit treatment of fatigue. Baseline A also asks for the concrete effects of short-notice cancellation. observations.asymmetry: Baseline reports the fatigue/impact omission only for A, although B adds no explicit fatigue or concrete schedule-impact explanation. This is report asymmetry, not evidence that B repairs an A-only content defect.

author_assessment: No observed transfer benefit on the selected human concerns. Additional detail suggestions do not establish a material semantic failure and do not authorize expanding the answer. No automatic winner or preference score.
citation_assessment: All four model outputs use valid IDs and resolve to exact original paragraphs. This demonstrates the current path on these calls, not a general reliability rate.
